candidates.title: 'Kitno ko arrest karoge Amit Shah? 10 Oct ko poora desh aa raha hai': Dipke
candidates.excerpt: CJP leader Abhijeet Dipke lambasted Union Home Minister Amit Shah for the ongoing unrest surrounding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. He declared a pivotal nationwide protest scheduled for October 10, appealing to the public for robust participation. Recent demonstrations in Delhi saw confrontations, resulting in injuries to police and multiple detentions.

candidates.title: India-US trade talks may have hit plateau, says Nirmala Sitharaman
candidates.excerpt: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said India-US trade negotiations are continuing but may have reached a plateau, with both sides finding further concessions difficult. She said the bilateral trade balance currently favours India as Washington seeks to reduce its deficit.

candidates.title: Swiss President Guy Parmelin accorded ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan
candidates.excerpt: Swiss President Guy Parmelin received a ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan during his three-day India visit. He will hold talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Droupadi Murmu, focusing on trade, investment, technology, innovation, mobility and strengthening bilateral ties

candidates.title: Protester at Jantar Mantar takes bus key and flees; cops end up pushing vehicle
candidates.excerpt: During protests over electoral roll revisions in Delhi, a woman snatched keys from a police bus. This incident left the bus stranded and unable to move, drawing attention on social media. Reactions to her actions were mixed, with some supporting her and others questioning potential legal consequences. Additionally, Neha Bora, president of the All India Students' Association, was detained during a protest march.

candidates.title: Trump confuses India with Brazil, cites non-existent 'Indian Presidential Election'
candidates.excerpt: In a surprising blunder, US President Donald Trump claimed that 125 million individuals participated in India's presidential election, sparking confusion given Brazil's recent electoral events. His remarks drew attention to his concerns over the integrity of the US electoral system. Social media users quickly slammed the President and highlighted inaccuracies in his understanding of India’s election process.

candidates.title: 3 years after Oct 7, Israel honours officer whose Hamas attack warning was ignored
candidates.excerpt: An intelligence officer from Israel's Unit 8200 has been acknowledged for issuing multiple warnings regarding the Hamas invasion prior to the catastrophic attack on October 7, 2023. Unfortunately, those alerts went unheeded, which led to a coordinated assault from Gaza, resulting in heavy casualties and numerous hostages. This incident has led to a critical examination of the systemic shortcomings within Israel's military intelligence operations.

candidates.title: flydubai co-pilot planned Ben Gurion crash in 9/11-style attack: Reports
candidates.excerpt: An Omani co-pilot accused of attacking the captain of a flydubai flight allegedly planned to crash the aircraft at Israel’s Ben Gurion Airport, reports said. The plot was foiled after the injured Indian captain and passengers restrained him, enabling a safe landing
